metadata.name: Synthetic exercise: evidence independence and contradiction
metadata.description: All records are invented for software testing, NOT observations from biology.

hypotheses.claim: Reducing senescent-cell burden would preserve selected tissue functions under specified conditions.
hypotheses.falsifier: Controlled perturbations show no benefit or unacceptable tradeoffs across matched endpoints.

hypotheses.claim: An epigenetic biomarker change predicts a sustained improvement in an independent functional endpoint.
hypotheses.falsifier: Biomarker changes fail to predict independently measured function in held-out cohorts.

evidence.summary: Invented favorable signal, for auditor unit tests only.
Invented secondary write-up of fake cohort A; not independent.
Invented contradictory outcome to test audit handling.
Invented biomarker association that must not count as evidence.
